text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali gives awards to top students and addresses ceremony; orders government measures to improve students' conditions.
- Ben Ali names Hechemi Gouadria governer of southern region of Mahdia and Mohsen Senoussi governor of district of Ben Arous.
- Argentine Deputy President Carlos Ruckauf starts nine-day official visit.
- Painter Gerard Di Maccio shows work; Ben Ali visits exhibition.
- Airline Tunis Air plans to buy 19 planes between 1997 and 2005.
